test_title: PYST 24: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 07 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0a1ff57ea87a6b0fd5fb732fcb057d20ecd77bde2730bd5ac0636f23c7d6174.png]
solution:
The image at the centre of the figure is moving in anti-clockwise direction. 

The next figure in the series must have the centre image as shown in option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cc8b8e79c8a1be4ea777ee03121d40ec9f639748ae58c1be19284e8b48f6228.png] 

So, option 1 will come next in the figure series.

Hence, '**option 1**' is the correct answer.
